tables.name: rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals
columns: trigger_rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
terminal_status_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(terminal_status_class IN ('terminal_closed','terminal_cancelled'))
scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('exact_rfc','root_branch'))
proposal_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(proposal_state IN ('pending','executed','superseded'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
executed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
superseded_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK((proposal_state='pending' AND executed_at_utc IS NULL AND executed_command_id IS NULL AND superseded_at_utc IS NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NULL) OR (proposal_state='executed' AND executed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND executed_command_id IS NOT NULL AND superseded_at_utc IS NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NULL) OR (proposal_state='superseded' AND executed_at_utc IS NULL AND executed_command_id IS NULL AND superseded_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND superseded_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: one pending proposal exists at most per trigger RFC/terminal epoch
a subordinate terminal epoch captures exact_rfc scope; a root/master terminal epoch captures the exact current two-level branch
proposal creation is atomic with acceptance of the terminal status projection that created the terminal epoch
proposal membership is immutable evidence; stale scope does not rewrite it
material scope change before execution blocks execution and requires a new proposal that supersedes the stale pending proposal while retaining the same terminal epoch
participant failure rolls back execution and leaves the proposal pending

tables.name: rfc_terminal_cascade_rfc_members
columns: rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
captured_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(captured_role IN ('root','subordinate','standalone'))
rules: rows are immutable exact proposal evidence
root-branch membership contains the root and every direct subordinate exactly once
exact-rfc membership contains only the triggering RFC

tables.name: rfc_terminal_cascade_wfm_members
columns: rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
owning_rfc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rfcs(rfc_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
captured_task_no TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(captured_task_no)=16 AND substr(captured_task_no,1,2)='TK' AND substr(captured_task_no,3) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
rules: task_id is immutable cross-domain Task identity supplied and revalidated by LLD-05; this snapshot table is evidence and does not own Task lifecycle
only applicable active nonterminal WFM members returned by the Task cascade participant are captured
Local Tasks are never captured merely because they reference the RFC

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rfc_terminal_pending_epoch ON rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(trigger_rfc_id,terminal_epoch_id) WHERE proposal_state='pending'
CREATE INDEX idx_rfc_terminal_executed_command ON rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(executed_command_id,rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id) WHERE executed_command_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_rfc_terminal_superseded_command ON rfc_terminal_cascade_proposals(superseded_command_id,rfc_terminal_cascade_proposal_id) WHERE superseded_command_id IS NOT NULL
database_guards: BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE on cascade RFC/WFM membership raises RFC_CASCADE_MEMBERSHIP_IMMUTABLE
cascade proposal UPDATE permits only governed pending->executed or pending->superseded transition fields; executed/superseded rows reject further UPDATE
BEFORE DELETE on cascade proposals raises RFC_CASCADE_HISTORY_APPEND_ONLY
cross_domain_fk_rule: WFM snapshot task_id intentionally has no physical FK in LLD-03 because LLD-05 owns Task schema and may be migrated later; capture and execution both validate immutable Task identity/revision through the same-UoW participant interface, and exact-schema verification treats this as an explicit cross-domain evidence reference rather than relational ownership.
